answer: The mirror index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 830 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the echo. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the mesa queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. A 307 account operation therefore ties up 19 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
